detailed_description:
The target video uses bright, realistic live-action UGC styling in a 16:9 frame, with natural window light, warm neutral colors, clear product detail, and energetic direct-to-camera delivery. The same 22-year-old white American woman has blue-gray eyes, long dark golden-brown curly hair, fair skin with natural freckles, and wears a beige knitted sweater.

[Shot 1] A handheld front-facing camera points toward a wooden bedroom table beside a white wall and bright window. Open delivery packaging and crumpled paper are scattered across the tabletop. The woman reaches into the box and lifts <Subject 1> from its wrapping into the foreground, keeping the gold antlers centered near the lens. Natural light glints across the brushed-gold surface while the black band hangs below. Her eyes widen and the corners of her mouth rise; her lips move continuously with clearly synchronized speech. The woman (S1) speaks brightly and excitedly, holding the product up as she says, <d>[English] Okay, this just showed up — you have to see this.</d> The camera holds a slightly shaky handheld framing and subtly pushes closer to the product.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a tight close-up of both hands rotating <Subject 1> slowly in front of the bedroom background. The antlers pass through the window light, revealing their brushed metallic grain, while the thin black band and both coated end tips appear in sequence. She lightly flicks one antler with her fingertip, making it give a soft tap. The woman (S1) continues with clear mouth articulation and a smooth demonstrative cadence, saying, <d>[English] Look at that brushed gold finish. And the band is thin, so nobody sees it.</d> The camera makes a small slow arc around the product to reveal its profile without changing its appearance.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a mirror-selfie view. The woman stands before a bedroom mirror in the same beige sweater, with her curls framing her face and the wooden table visible behind her. She places <Subject 1> over the crown of her head, slides it into position, and smooths stray hair around the band. She turns her head left and right to check the antler placement, then faces the camera and points upward at the antlers. The camera tracks her small head movement with a gentle handheld sway. With rising enthusiasm and clearly synchronized lips, the woman (S1) says, <d>[English] It's super light, no headache — and look how the antlers sit.</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a tighter selfie close-up. Wearing <Subject 1>, she leans toward the lens, smiles broadly, and raises both hands beside her head to imitate antlers with her fingers. Bright window light outlines the gold antlers and her hair. Maintaining direct eye contact, the woman (S1) speaks continuously in a cheerful inviting tone with visible mouth movement, saying, <d>[English] Grab one before your holiday party — link's right here.</d> She holds the playful pose through the final frame at 00:15.000.

overall_soundscape:
Soft bedroom room tone and faint outdoor ambience continue throughout. Packaging paper rustles in Shot 1, the headband gives a light fingertip tap in Shot 2, and subtle sweater and hair movement sounds accompany the mirror selfie shots.
